stories.title: Manitoba throne speech to include ban on AI images in real estate
stories.summary: Premier Wab Kinew, at his NDP's annual convention on the weekend, talked about next year's general election and a focus on health care and affordability.

stories.title: Winnipeg Jets’ Mark Scheifele named 1st star of the week after record-breaking performance
stories.summary: Mark Scheifele was named a player of the week for the 10th time in his career after breaking Jets franchise records.

stories.title: Dale Hawerchuk’s son reflects on ‘surreal’ Scheifele record for Winnipeg Jets
stories.summary: "Sometimes life is stranger than fiction," says the son of Jets legend Dale Hawerchuk, as he reflected on Mark Scheifele becoming the franchise's all-time leading scorer.

stories.title: 300-pound church bell stolen in Manitoba’s Interlake region: RCMP
stories.summary: Police are investigating after a church bell was stolen in the RM of Armstrong. The Manitoba RCMP said it is unclear how or when the alleged theft occurred.

stories.title: 4 people charged with manslaughter after death of 33-year-old in Winnipeg
stories.summary: Three men and one female teenager are facing manslaughter charges in relation to the death of Kyle Andrew Devon Jerome in Winnipeg.

stories.title: Canada’s Alert Ready emergency system will test notifications on Wednesday
stories.summary: The emergency alerts are used by governments to inform the public of emergencies including tornadoes, floods, wildfires and Amber Alerts

stories.title: ‘Fresh slate’: Former Manitoba PC leader set to take new seat as Independent
stories.summary: Obby Khan, former leader of the province's Progressive Conservatives, says he plans to take his seat in the assembly as an Independent.

stories.title: Jets rally from 4-0 down to beat Blackhawks 5-4
stories.summary: Mark Scheifele made history with a goal and three assists, helping the Jets rally from a four-goal deficit to beat the Chicago Blackhawks 5-4 on Saturday.

stories.title: Manitoba may need to spend far less on new power generation: Kinew
stories.summary: Manitoba Premier Wab Kinew says the province may need to spend far less than previously thought on new power plants based on Manitoba Public Utilities Board information.

stories.title: Employer charged for ‘exploiting employees for financial benefit’ in Manitoba
stories.summary: A 48-year-old Dauphin man is facing charges following a 13-month investigation into the treatment of temporary foreign workers at his business, the RCMP said.
